request-prompt: Place a bulleted 'Quick Summary' box right below the article headline, and move the key weather infographic/forecast image to the top of the article body above the main text.
goal: I prefer quick, visual summaries, bullet points, and quick infographics so I can understand the news in under thirty seconds.
jobs: I want to find out when and how the rescheduled Indy 500 qualifying session will take place.
I want to check the weather forecast for Indianapolis on Sunday to see if rain will delay the events again.
I want to access the official rules and draw document for the condensed Sunday qualifying session.
I want to share this news update with fellow racing fans who are following the Indy 500.
I want to see what other fans are saying about the weather delay and join the discussion.
I want to look up the current weather forecast for my local area using the search function.
